Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Enabled_toolt: A rain collector plumbed into a building feeds every plumbed fixture in it, not just the one right below. Turn this off for normal plumbing.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Reach_tooltip: How far a fixture looks for barrels when it is not in a real building, like a base you built yourself. Inside a real building the whole building is used and this does nothing. 12 covers a good sized base.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FedFixtures_t: Things that can be plumbed in to be FILLED by the supply instead of feeding it. Water dispensers by default. You still have to right-click one and plumb it with a pipe wrench. Use the object's script name, separated by semicolons. Clear the box to turn this off.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_WasherPatch_t: Fixes two base game bugs on servers: a washing machine you cannot plumb, and one that keeps running on your screen after it runs dry. Singleplayer does not need it.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_FluidPatch_to: Fixes a base game bug that empties your barrels without filling anything. It only hits drinks like cola, juice and vodka. Water, beer and whiskey were never affected.
Sandbox_LGExtendedPlumbing_Debug_tooltip: Writes every plumbing change to the log file. Only useful for tracking down a problem.
